name: 主动额外成果
unrequested_rule: Beyond the supplied task and required goals, including any required self-chosen extension; retained A1 without an invitation or follow-up request.
deduplication: An independent mathematical result and its equivalents, proof steps and direct corollaries form one source-bound group within a task; repeated delivery in final text and manuscript is not counted twice.
unknown_rule: Report verified group counts and reviewed task coverage only; incomplete coverage leaves the total unknown, with no extrapolation or finite upper bound.
interpretation: Observed initiative in these answers, not research capability; the usefulness of additional results depends on the research context, and more is not necessarily better.
novelty_scope: relative to supplied material and required delivery; no claim of literature novelty
value_judgment: Context-dependent on the research problem and intended use; not an observation-counting gate.
